title: Essentially finite type algebras over a P-ring are P-rings
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)

difficulty_reason: The proposition shows that an essentially finite type algebra over a P-ring, for a property P satisfying the listed conditions, is again a P-ring. The proof first records that being a P-ring is a local condition, which reduces to prime localisations of finite type algebras; quoting the quasi-finite ascent result reduces further to polynomial algebras, and by induction to one variable. There the author invokes the criterion on formal fibres, replaces the base by its localisation, and then compares the completion of the localised polynomial ring with the completion of the localised polynomial ring over the completed base, feeding the fibrewise information through the permanence conditions (A), (C) and (D) and the regularity of the right vertical arrow supplied by the G-ring property of complete Noetherian rings.
